meta.description: ATAC-seq library quality control -- TSS enrichment, FRiP, fragment-size periodicity, library complexity (NRF/PBC1/PBC2), mitochondrial fraction, and ENCODE 4 thresholds.

scientific_integrity.detail: No fabricated citations or values observed; attribution of the 0.7-0.9 NRF/PBC bands to Landt 2012 is unverified and filed as P3 ATAC-QC-010

practice_boundaries.detail: QC guidance for research data; no clinical claims

methodological_ground.detail: NRF/PBC on single-end read starts is a serious method mismatch (ATAC-QC-001, P1) but implements the Skill's literal stated definition and is not a correlation/causation-class fallacy; escalated as P1 rather than veto

code_usability.detail: All four scripts and the CLI recipes ran on numpy 2.5, pandas 3.0 and deepTools 4.0 without modification

functional_suitability.note: Workflow covers the seven ENCODE metrics, but documented NRF/PBC filters, periodicity classification and per-sample MultiQC output are not delivered by the shipped scripts

reliability.note: Some inputs fail loudly, but absent chromosomes, empty TSS BEDs and minus-strand gene intervals return 0.0 or wrong values with exit 0

performance_context.note: SKILL.md is about 11 KB with routed references; thresholds and failure modes are deferred correctly

agent_usability.note: Clear workflow and thresholds; bigWig construction, preseq -P and the TSS BED contract require inference

human_usability.note: Usage guide has prompts and tips; no worked sample-level example or expected output layout

security.note: No credentials, shell injection or destructive operations; scripts only read supplied paths

maintainability.note: Small modular scripts with docstrings; no tests or fixtures shipped; Pearson vs Spearman contradiction in references

agent_specific.note: Trigger description is precise and version-drift guidance present; several documented behaviors do not match the scripts

Scripts are small, dependency-light and run unchanged on current numpy/pandas/deepTools majors

recommendations.title: library_complexity.py NRF/PBC are single-end read-start m...
recommendations.problem: On paired-end ATAC BAMs the script keys each mate by (chr, start, strand). Unfiltered rep1: 0.353/0.632/3.40 vs independent fragment NRF/PBC1/PBC2 0.619/0.767/4.87 (MAPQ>=30: 0.779/0.799/5.10); the ENCODE-filtered deduplicated BAM gives 0.573 instead of the 1.0 the Skill states. Grading against the 0.7 reject line would fail acceptable libraries.
recommendations.root_cause: Skill defines NRF over reads/positions and the script never pairs mates.
recommendations.fix: Compute on fragments (chr, fragment start, end) for paired-end input, keep a single-end mode, use 5-prime coordinates for reverse reads, and state definition and units in SKILL.md and method-reference.md.

recommendations.title: library_complexity.py ignores documented MAPQ>=30, chrM e...
recommendations.problem: Docs say NRF/PBC run after MAPQ>=30 filtering; a planted BAM with 100 unique nuclear reads plus 100 chrM and 100 MAPQ0 duplicates returned total 300, NRF 0.34 instead of 100 and 1.0.
recommendations.root_cause: Filtering is left to an undocumented pre-step and the script has no options.
recommendations.fix: Add --min-mapq and contig-exclusion defaults matching the Skill, or state the required pre-filter command.

recommendations.title: aggregate_qc.py output is not per-sample or MultiQC-compa...
recommendations.problem: Long-format metric/value/flag TSV; MultiQC custom content parsed 7 metric rows as 7 samples. No sample column, no overall grade, missing metrics produce no row, string values raise TypeError.
recommendations.root_cause: Docs describe a per-sample report card and _mqc.tsv that the script does not write.
recommendations.fix: Emit a sample-wide _mqc.tsv with headers and an overall grade, report missing required metrics as NA, validate numeric types, or correct the documentation.

recommendations.title: encode_tss_enrichment.py returns wrong or zero scores wit...
recommendations.problem: Planted bigWig with true score 21.0: minus-strand gene interval (start,end) scored 1.0 because start is used as TSS; a chromosome absent from the bigWig and an empty BED both return 0.0 with success; strand is read from the last column so a name column after strand defaults to plus; used and skipped TSS counts are never reported.
recommendations.root_cause: Input contract is only 'chrom start end ... strand' and skipped TSS are swallowed.
recommendations.fix: Document that the BED must be 1 bp TSS with strand in column 6, read column 6, report used/skipped TSS counts, and exit nonzero when none are used.

recommendations.title: TSS bigWig recipe undocumented; score depends on it; pyTS...
recommendations.problem: Same BAM and TSS set gives 11.32 (bamCoverage --extendReads), 14.92 (plain), 15.98 (--Offset 1) and 11.48 (CPM, bin 10). Skill and usage guide call the script the ENCODE pyTSSe convention but give no bigWig command and no comparison to ENCODE-reported values.
recommendations.root_cause: Signal-track construction is a hidden parameter of the metric.
recommendations.fix: Add the exact bamCoverage command (bin size 1, chosen read representation), state the ENCODE reference method or soften the pyTSSe equivalence, and note that scores differ by recipe.

recommendations.title: preseq recipes omit -P for paired-end BAMs; c_curve step ...
recommendations.problem: On the deduplicated paired BAM c_curve without -P reports 305,029 distinct of 500,000 reads while -P reports 500,001 of 524,024. Without -P preseq counted 929,546 reads for 1.82M mates. c_curve -s 1e6 returns only the 0 0 row when depth is below the step; -P fails on name-sorted input.
recommendations.root_cause: Commands were copied from single-end preseq usage.
recommendations.fix: Use -B -P on a coordinate-sorted BAM for paired-end ATAC, state that deduplicated BAMs are unsuitable for lc_extrap, and set the step relative to depth.

recommendations.title: atac_qc_metrics.R does not classify periodicity and label...
recommendations.problem: Workflow step 3 and the usage guide promise periodicity classification; the script only counts NFR/mono/di/tri. nuclear_reads_M counts pairs including chrM and duplicates yet is graded against the ENCODE nuclear-read threshold.
recommendations.root_cause: Metric naming and documentation overstate what the script computes.
recommendations.fix: Implement the documented pattern classification and chrM/duplicate exclusion, or rename the field and correct the docs.

recommendations.title: atac_qc_metrics.R input contract: .bed.gz narrowPeak fail...
recommendations.problem: ENCODE narrowPeak distributed as .bed.gz fails with scan() expected an integer, got 22.06932. TxDb hg38 is fixed with no genome argument or seqlevels check.
recommendations.root_cause: rtracklayer infers format from the extension.
recommendations.fix: Pass format='narrowPeak' to import or document supported extensions; expose the genome/TxDb as an argument.

recommendations.title: library_complexity.py emits non-standard JSON Infinity fo...
recommendations.problem: All-singleton BAM prints PBC2 Infinity, rejected by strict JSON parsers.
recommendations.fix: Emit null or a string when PBC2 is undefined.

recommendations.title: Reference inconsistencies and unverified threshold attrib...
recommendations.problem: method-reference.md says Pearson correlation on binned counts while the recipe and tips use Spearman; NRF/PBC 0.7-0.9 bands are attributed to Landt 2012 although the Skill says the PBC1/PBC2 split is a later refinement (not verified against ENCODE pages in this pass); the usage guide lists a Picard insert-size step with no command in the Skill; prerequisites omit preseq.
recommendations.root_cause: Compiled from several sources without reconciliation.
recommendations.fix: Reconcile to Spearman, verify each threshold against the current ENCODE ATAC standards and cite the exact source, add the Picard command and preseq install line.
